plan.summary: FEAT-TFM-FLOW Picker (P4): PlaceholderPicker'a `tfmAware?: boolean` prop + 2-grup dropdown render (Semantic Alanlar + INMA Ham Alanlar). Yeni `useFieldMapping.ts` hook (useDynamicFields ikizi: module cache + single-flight + errorKind). Semantic token `{{<semantic>}}` literal insert; backend TFM resolver runtime'da cf1'e cevirir (ITenantFieldMappingResolver). INMA ham token mevcut davranis. TFM mapping yoksa empty/fail = semantic grup gizli, sadece INMA ham liste. TemplateCreatePage + flow-builder NodePropertyPanel `tfmAware={true}` explicit opt-in. renderDynamicPreview helper opt-in mapping parametresi: semantic token'lari source cf'in hardcoded demo degeriyle substitute eder.

Q6 default = false, 2 consumer'da explicit true. Q7 preview = semantic substitute opt-in mapping param. AC1-AC8 Q onayli.

files_changed.change: New hook (useDynamicFields ikizi) — module cache + single-flight + errorKind + enabled flag for stable hook-order when consumer opts out.
tfmAware prop + 2-group dropdown (Semantic + INMA Ham). renderDynamicPreview opt-in mapping parameter for semantic token substitution.
tfmAware={true} on PlaceholderPicker; triggerLabel 'INMA alani' → 'Dinamik alan' since the dropdown may now include semantic entries too.

verification_questions.question: Does PlaceholderPicker render 2 distinct groups when tfmAware=true (Semantic Alanlar + INMA Ham Alanlar) with clear visual separation, and does tfmAware=false preserve the existing FEAT-DMP single-list behavior exactly (zero regression for TemplateCreate/NodePropertyPanel consumers that don't opt in)?

Does useFieldMapping hook mirror useDynamicFields lifecycle (module-level moduleCache, inflight Promise coalescing, errorKind enum, mounted-guard via isMountedRef) without sharing state with useDynamicFields? Does the TFM fetch error gracefully fall back to INMA-only mode in the picker (not a hard picker failure)?

When a semantic entry is clicked, does handleSelect emit `{{<semantic>}}` token literal (NOT `{{cf1}}` raw)? Backend resolver path (ITenantFieldMappingResolver.ResolveToInmaKey -> cf1) is responsible for render-time resolution; UI must NOT pre-resolve.

Is the renderDynamicPreview mapping parameter handled correctly: optional + defaults to {} + semantic token lookup maps to source cf demo value via the existing cf1..cf10 defaults table? Unmapped semantic tokens must return the literal match (no silent replacement).

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: TFM fetch fail sessizce fall-back normal — tenant onceki davranisi aynen alir (INMA grup canli). Kullanici semantic mapping'i kurmamis-veya-alinmamissa FEAT-DMP ile aynisini gorur. Ops log errorKind via useFieldMapping state; Dashboard console warn INV-OB-037 pattern (useDynamicFields ile ayni). Silent DEGIL — structured log + errorKind state tracked.
